answer: Because the timing is logged against the ridge challenge, the cedar audit can replay the juniper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 135 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 23 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
